item.title: SS13 SERVER
item.description:
YOU CAN NOW HANG PEOPLE AND PLAY AS 'CADO

SERVER IP (paste this into your browser search bar and hit enter, if you've downloaded byond and logged in that will work)
byond://ss13.soyjak.st:41237

What is Space Station 13
Space station 13 is a deception game taken place onboard a space station owned by a megacorporation thats bordering on being its own government entity. It is very similar to Trouble in Terrorist Town and players may choose from around 45 jobs to play as all with unique mechanics and gameplay, while a select few percent of the crew are selected to be Antagonists, their goal to stop the operations of the space station or whatever else may be required of them and are given a unique set of abillities and equipment to do so, they might be shapeshifting aliens, rival corporations with smuggled equipment, or part of radical cults with real magic.

How do I join?
1. Download byond from https://www.byond.com/download/build/515/515.1647_byond_setup.zip (Or if you use linux https://www.byond.com/download/build/515/515.1647_byond_linux.zip )
Let it download into the default directory it wants to, but if you don't have space there it should be fine to move it, do not update to 516 as it is too buggy to reliably play.

2. You also need to register at https://secure.byond.com/?page=Join this requires an email vertification but any tempmail service works and is not blocked.

3. One its finished downloading and you are done registering load up byond (it should launch on start but may not appear, access it through search bar or the arrow button and click on the logo) and then log in

4. Past the server IP (byond://ss13.soyjak.st:41237) into your browser search bar and allow it to take you, you can use Crlt + O in byond then paste the link into the top box then press "OK"

5. You have joined the server, click setup character to make a character, then join game to pick a job, anything else you can press O to ask the entire server a question or F1 to ask an admin a question/report someone posting 'p

item.title: Not just another day...
item.description:
Good evening, my fellow Americans. Today, we remember a day that forever changed the landscape of our digital world—a day that tested our resolve and brought us together in the face of chaos. It was a moment that reshaped our soysphere, impacting all who were part of it.

Now, some of you young folks might be part of places like soyjak.party. But back in the day, we didn’t have all these modern splinters and sister sites. We had /qa/ and /qa2/, and that was enough. It was a community—a place where people could come together to share, laugh, and find a sense of belonging.

But then came that fateful day when the twin boards, /qa/ and /qa2/, were under siege. Not by anything physical, but by waves of bots unleashed by groups of transgender anime watchers, flooding the boards with 'p spam and troonslop. The once vibrant discussions were thrown into disarray, as these bots sought to overwhelm and disrupt. But in the face of this onslaught, the community didn’t back down. They fought back with their best soyjaks, hanging troonjaks, and every bit of digital fortitude they had. The boards may have been under attack, but their spirit remained unbroken.

This wasn’t just another online skirmish—it was a defining moment that affected us all, from the largest communities to the most niche corners of the internet. It’s important to remember that no matter where we hang out, we’re all part of the same big ol’ digital family.

So keep on doing what you do, but remember the lessons we’ve learned: stay strong, stay united, and keep the soyjaks flowing. And to all my friends at soyjak.party—keep jakkin’. God bless you, and God bless the soysphere.

item.title: Mediator Apps are open
item.description:
This round, we are hiring a new staff role called Mediator. Think of mediators like junior jannies. Mediators will serve as eyes on the catalogue all around the clock and they will vote toward post deletion. Mediators who prove to be reliable and demonstrate consistently good moderation can earn themselves janny positions. They have emergency deletions for the rare occasion illegal content would trigger a false negative on the filter. With numerous mediators to support our jannies, the ever growing 'Party will have a balanced mod presence.

https://soyjak.party/survey/?r=survey/index&sid=891442

There is no timezone requirement for this hiring round. We want to hire diverse timezones to ensure good coverage all day. If you're one of the 6 guys who've emailed me wanting to be a janny, I'll reply with the survey.
